room_rent.note: If room taken at higher rate, all other expenses (except medicines) reimbursed proportionately

icu.note: Proportionate deduction applies if ICU charges exceed limit

copayment.note: Mandatory 5% co-payment on every admissible claim amount

sub_limits.display: Cataract capped at 25% of SI or ₹40,000/eye/year (lower); modern treatments up to 50% of SI
sub_limits.note: Cataract sub-limit; modern treatments sub-limited to 50% SI; room/ICU daily caps apply

ped_waiting.note: Reduced to extent of prior continuous coverage under portability

specific_disease_waiting.note: 24-month list includes cataract, hernia, hydrocele, piles, etc.; 36-month list includes joint replacement and osteoporosis

cumulative_bonus.note: 5% added per claim-free year; reduced at same rate on claim. Alternatively, insured may opt No Claim Discount (6%/3%/1% on renewal premium by SI band) instead — choice is permanent

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in policy wording

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation excluded; optional Galaxy Smart Outpatient rider available

ayush.note: Inpatient AYUSH treatment covered up to full sum insured in AYUSH hospitals

organ_donor.note: No mention of organ donor expenses in policy wording

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed procedures including robotic surgery, stereotactic radio surgery, oral chemotherapy, stem cell therapy etc.

consumables.note: Extensive list of non-medical/consumable items explicitly excluded (List I, Annexure I)

global_cover.note: Policy restricted to India; treatment outside India excluded

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months no claim contestable except fraud and permanent exclusions

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only, not on renewals or portability

notable_exclusions: Maternity, domiciliary/OPD, refractive error <7.5D, sterility/infertility, cosmetic surgery, obesity surgery, gender change, war, nuclear/bio/chemical attack, treatment outside India
optional_riders: Galaxy Smart Outpatient rider (covers domiciliary hospitalisation and OPD treatment)
